title: Automatic techniques for security bug report identification: A systematic mapping study
abstract: arXiv:2611.18581v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Several studies have investigated the use of automated techniques to help practitioners identify security bug reports early in the defect management process. However, currently there is no comprehensive overview of this research area. Such an overview will help identify future research directions and consolidate the potentially relevant existing solutions. This study aims to provide a comprehensive overview of automated techniques for identifying security bug reports. To achieve this, we conducted a systematic mapping study and identified 28 primary studies.   The study's findings show that the literature has evaluated various automatic techniques for identifying security bug reports, including traditional machine learning, deep learning, and more advanced large language models. translated_title: 安全缺陷报告识别的自动化技术：一项系统性映射研究
translated_abstract: 多项研究已探讨了使用自动化技术来帮助从业者在缺陷管理过程的早期识别安全缺陷报告。然而，目前该研究领域尚缺乏全面的综述。这样的综述将有助于确定未来的研究方向，并整合现有的潜在相关解决方案。本研究旨在为识别安全缺陷报告的自动化技术提供全面的概述。为此，我们开展了一项系统性映射研究，并识别出28项原始研究。研究结果表明，文献中已评估了多种用于识别安全缺陷报告的自动化技术，包括传统机器学习、深度学习以及更先进的大语言模型。研究识别出的两大主要挑战是标注数据的缺乏和数据不平衡。此外，我们观察到现有研究缺乏在真实工业环境中的评估。
tldr: 本研究通过系统性映射综述了28项关于自动识别安全缺陷报告的研究，发现所用技术涵盖传统机器学习、深度学习和大语言模型，主要挑战在于标注数据缺乏和数据不平衡，且现有研究缺少真实工业环境中的评估。
en_tdlr: This systematic mapping study overviews 28 primary studies on automated techniques for identifying security bug reports—spanning traditional machine learning, deep learning, and large language models—and identifies lack of labeled data and data imbalance as key challenges, while noting the absence of evaluations in real industrial settings.
